name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A carousel whose middle slide is always whole while its neighbours fade out at the edges. It follows your pointer 1:1, resists past the ends like iOS and lands on a slide with one spring that keeps your release speed, without a wobble. Arrows, dots and keys; no auto rotation.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)

.am-carousel-viewport.-webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 var(--am-carousel-fade), #000 calc(100% - var(--am-carousel-fade)), transparent)
.am-carousel-viewport.mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 var(--am-carousel-fade), #000 calc(100% - var(--am-carousel-fade)), transparent)

.am-carousel-indicator.clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--am-carousel-dot) - var(--am-carousel-to, 0) * (var(--am-carousel-dot) + var(--am-carousel-dot-gap))) 0 calc(var(--am-carousel-from, 0) * (var(--am-carousel-dot) + var(--am-carousel-dot-gap))) round 9999px)

docs:
Carousel from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Carousel } from "@/components/ui/motion-carousel".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-carousel.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createCarousel on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/carousel/carousel.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#carousel
